routes.label: British Overseas Territory (St Helena) passport, issued on the island

note: Fees from 16 October 2017 (Legal Notice No. 20 of 2017), in pounds, read as St Helena pounds; no later order was found. A child is 'aged 16 years and under'. The temporary (GBP 40) and emergency (5.50) passports aren't modelled, nor the handling fee for a British passport printed in the UK (18.80). Validity and processing time are leads.

sources.title: St Helena Government (sainthelena.gov.sh), Legal Notice No. 20 of 2017, Passport (Fees)(Amendment) Order, 2017
sources.said: This Order may be cited as the Passport (Fees)(Amendment) Order, 2017, and comes into force on 16 October 2017. ... FEES PAYABLE TO IMMIGRATION OFFICER 1. Issue of British Overseas Territory (St Helena) passport: Adult £60.00 Child (aged 16 years and under) £30.00 Temporary passport (8 pages) £40.00 Emergency passport (1 page) £ 5.50 2. Issue of British passport – handling fee £18.80
